build_system: stdlib-only Python, uv for test runner
test_framework: pytest via uv run --with pytest pytest
verification_instructions: 1) Copy runtime/ to /app/runtime/, tests/ to /tests/, solution/ to /solution/. 2) Run orchestrator (NOP/buggy) then pytest - expect 8 pass, 6 fail. 3) Remove state files, run solve.sh, then pytest - expect 14 pass, 0 fail.
snapshot_or_generated_files: runtime/clash_state.jsonl and runtime/armada_report.json are generated by orchestrator.py at runtime
setup_instructions: Files are self-contained stdlib Python. No install needed. uv and pytest available globally.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - no external package downloads. Only stdlib Python 3.11 available at runtime. uv and pytest pre-installed in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing lattice-propagation-repair pattern exactly. Include Dockerfile, environment/runtime/ copy, test.sh with reward.txt, solve.sh + repair script, task.toml, instruction.md.
key_patterns: Existing task uses: pipe/JSON data files, orchestrator as main entry, engine/analyzer/report separation, 14 pytest tests in tiers, repair script with string replacements, Dockerfile copies runtime/ to /app/runtime/
directory_structure: armada-clash-repair/ with: environment/ (Dockerfile + runtime/ copy), runtime/ (source), tests/ (test.sh + pytest file), solution/ (solve.sh + repair script), instruction.md, task.toml
